SETTINGS

How this app opens for you.

These are your preferences, stored on this browser under the name you pick below. They change how the app looks and what it opens on — they don't hide data or restrict anyone. There's no password here on purpose: a password checked in the page's own JavaScript wouldn't keep anyone out, since anyone with the link can read the check and pick any name. Real accounts need a login server.

Used to attribute requests and tasks, and to keep these settings separate per person on a shared machine.
Sponsor Ledger default view What the ledger opens on.
Default season The season selected when the app loads.
Appearance Dark mode is new — a few dense screens still need a pass.
Fulfillment math Per asset: every asset counts the same. Dollar-weighted: assets count by rate-card value.
Background texture and motion Drifting waves behind the page and the sticker texture in the sidebar. Off if you find it distracting — it turns itself off if your system asks for reduced motion.
Desktop notifications Show a computer alert when you are mentioned, assigned, or needed for approval. Your browser may ask for permission.
Email composer Choose where BlueClaws IQ opens drafted request and approval emails on this device.
Pipeline stage close % Sets each deal stage's odds of closing — drives the Probability Value forecast in the Renewal Center. Signed is always 100%, Lost always 0%.
How fulfillment is scored. Complete 100% · In Process 55% · Waiting On 20% · Need To Do 0%. A sponsor's percentage is the average of those values across every asset on their deal, so 3 of 6 assets complete reads 50%.
